label: common_0047_mama_01
text: Oh, just look at you! All ready for your big\nfirst day![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0047_head_teacher_01
text: Yes, the uniform of our storied academy suits you\nquite well indeed.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0047_head_teacher_02
text: Oh, gracious. How very careless of me.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0047_head_teacher_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I had entirely forgotten that I’ve something else
for you, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
A most
important
thing.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0047_head_teacher_04
text: But your living room is hardly the place for it.\nWould you care to follow me outside?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0047_mama_02
text: I wonder what this important thing might be...\nLet’s follow the director out and see, shall we?[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
